_doc: The One tree and the plan strip on both phones (ov-300): inputs in the wire's own shapes, and the outline and strip both ports must produce. Read by AgentKit's PhoneTreeCasesTests and Android's OneTreeCasesTest. Outline lines: two spaces a level, then kind, key and title, then detail, caption and also, then a bullet for a dot; lowercased, since iOS says titles in title case and Android in sentence case.
